title: Who eats whom in the room's aquarium (D152)

preyRatio.description: A predator can eat a fish shorter than this share of its own length.

chancePerDay.description: The chance in a hundred, each game day, that a predator with prey in the tank eats one.

days.description: The most days counted at once when the player comes back.

fedDays.description: Game days a bait fed to the tank keeps the predators from hunting.

hideRatio.description: Drawn swimming, a fish keeps away from a predator whose species is this many times its size.
